orders: Assess for lid retraction (Dalrymple's sign) and lid lag on downgaze (von Graefe's sign).
Perform a slit lamp examination to evaluate the conjunctiva and sclera.
Assess pupil size and reactivity to light and accommodation (specifically looking for anisocoria or a relative afferent pupillary defect).
Assess for convergence insufficiency (ask patient to look at a target moving towards the nose).
MRI of the brain with diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) to evaluate for acute ischemic stroke in the pons/midbrain.
served: abducting nystagmus of the fellow eye
